subject: For Aiden Karacsony and Cristiano Morais, the pre-match is the main event.
posts:
Community and passion define the local sports experience. Sometimes the ritual is just as important as the result.
Evidence: personal joy, community building, shared experience
#Aletheia #Sports

The claim is that these pre-match rituals build lasting bonds and celebrate local culture.
